signals.source_text: Six times more RF spectrum coverage. Four times more processing and AI compute. Thirty-one times more storage. Those are some of the gains behind DroneShield ’s new RfRecon platform, which combines RF sensing, direction finding, and RfAI-3 intelligence in a portable system designed to improve tactical spectrum awareness and support faster decision-making. Elsewhere, Greensea IQ has introduced Bayonet Sweep, an autonomous underwater robot designed to inspect ship hulls and harbor infrastructure for potential threats without requiring manual diver sweeps. Embention USA and SkyRunner, LLC are integrating Veronte Autopilot with the MK 3.2 dual-mode air-ground vehicle to add autonomous and remote-piloted capabilities, while Iridium examines how satellite connectivity can support C2, tracking, and data communications for long-range BVLOS drone operations. At the computing layer, Wolf Advanced Technology explores the growing role of compact, rugged edge computing for AI, video, networking, and sensor processing in European defense applications. Looking further ahead, UTES2026 will bring together industry, academia, and research at Chalmers University of Technology to explore autonomous technologies spanning uncrewed aviation, advanced air mobility, and future space missions. Catch up on the full stories in this week’s Unmanned Systems Technology newsletter ⬇️

signals.source_text: The EV didn't make NVH easier. It pushed the noise higher. Motor whine past 5 kHz. Gear mesh. Inverter harmonics. Road noise now the loudest source in the cabin. The critical band runs 100 Hz to 5 kHz, and no single method covers it. The Engineer's Guide to Modern NVH Simulation shows how to work the full range in MSC Nastran and Actran: heavy-fluid coupling, Virtual SEA, and ODYSSEE ROMs. Preview the first pages, then download the full guide below 👇

signals.source_text: Mikrodalga retroreflektörü ile donatılmış bir insansız hava aracı — bu cihaz, radar sinyallerini nesnenin gerçek boyutunun yaklaşık yirmi katı güçte geri yansıtan bir cihazdır — bir radar sinyalini gerçek bir saldırı insansız hava aracıymış gibi göstermek üzere tasarlanmıştır. Spectr adı verilen bu hava aracı, kendi insansız hava aracı sistemlerini üreten ve hammaddeden bitmiş donanıma kadar entegre bir tedarik zincirini yöneten, Birleşik Krallık merkezli bir savunma teknolojisi şirketi olan OM Defence Systems tarafından üretilmiştir. Spectr, akıllı bir tuzak görevi görüyor ve gerçek saldırı insansız hava araçları ulaşmadan önce düşmanın hava savunma ağını aldatmak, dikkatini dağıtmak ve yormak üzere tasarlanmıştır. Spectr’in ele aldığı sorun, modern savaşta en maliyetli dengesizliklerden biri haline gelmiştir ve hem Batı, hem Rus, hem de Çin hava savunma sistemlerine karşı etkilidir. Tek bir ABD Patriot önleme füzesinin maliyeti ABD ordusu için mermi başına yaklaşık 3 milyon dolar iken, Çin’in de lisans ve ihracat satın alımı yoluyla kullandığı Rusya’nın S-400 sistemi, tanesi 1 milyon ila 2 milyon dolar arasında olduğu tahmin edilen önleme füzeleri ateşler ve yüz milyonlarca dolara mal olan tam bir bataryaya dayanır. Rusya’nın Ukrayna’ya binlerce adet fırlattığı Shahed tipi saldırı insansız hava aracı ise 30.000 dolar gibi düşük bir maliyetle üretilebiliyor. https://lnkd.in/dhk9iNqu

signals.source_text: 🏆 On its debut at the International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence (IOAI) , the Czech National AI Team brought home two medals. In Astana, Kazakhstan, Patrik Řezníček took bronze, and Jan Herza went one better with silver. The Czechs held their own among 440 competitors from 95 countries and regions. Over two six-hour rounds and six tasks, they had to quickly read the input data and metrics and turn their ideas into a working solution. The Czech National AI Team emerged from the first edition of the Česká AI Olympiáda organised by nvias.org . We are glad that prg.ai , as a partner of the event, could support the Prague regional round – helping with its organisation, funding, and securing mentors and the expert jury. The success of Czech students on the international stage means a great deal to us, and we will be following the team's next steps closely.
